# Data dictionary

*Generated by `data_preprocessing/preprocessing.py`. Edit the schema there, not this file.*

**As-of date:** 2026-11-02. Treat this as "today" when working out what is recent or overdue.

## Status codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `I` | In progress |
| `C` | Completed |
| `X` | Cancelled |

## Formats

- Files are UTF-8 CSV. A blank cell means no value.
- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Amounts have three decimals, because rounding to two breaks the order totals.
- IDs and postal codes are text. Load them as text, or their leading zeros will be lost.

## Source and changes

Derived from SAP's Bikes Sales sample in [datasphere-content](https://github.com/SAP-samples/datasphere-content), © SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company, licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `data/raw/LICENSE`). The changes from the original are:

- Merged addresses into partners, and product texts and categories into products, in English.
- Dropped empty and uninformative columns, including `PARTNERROLE`, which did not separate partners.
- Renamed item amounts as unit amounts, because they are per unit, and added line totals.
- Moved all dates forward by a fixed number of days and recalculated fiscal periods.
- Re-dated partners and products to before the first order.
- Moved delivery dates that came before the order's creation to the order's last-change date.
- Blanked placeholder delivery dates on cancelled orders, and suppliers that don't exist.
- Corrected the country code `DU` to `AE`, and cleaned stray spaces from text.
- Derived `sales_org` for employees from their address region.

No partners, products, employees, orders or order lines were added or removed.

## partners

Companies that place orders and supply products, with their address. 40 rows. Key: `partner_id`.

| Column | Type | Can be blank | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `partner_id` | text | No | Partner ID, zero-padded. |
| `company_name` | text | No | Company name. |
| `legal_form` | text | No | Legal form, such as Inc. or GmbH. |
| `email` | text | No | Contact email. |
| `phone` | text | No | Contact phone number. |
| `website` | text | No | Company website. |
| `street` | text | No | Street name. |
| `building` | text | Yes | Building number. |
| `city` | text | No | City. |
| `postal_code` | text | No | Postal code. Text, because some have leading zeros. |
| `country` | text | No | ISO 3166 two-letter country code. |
| `region` | text | No | Sales region: AMER, APJ or EMEA. |
| `preferred_currency` | text | No | The partner's own currency. Orders are not converted to it. |
| `created_by` | text | No | Employee who created the partner. |
| `created_at` | date | No | Date the partner was created. |
| `changed_by` | text | No | Employee who last changed the partner. |
| `changed_at` | date | No | Date the partner was last changed. |

## products

The product catalogue, with English names and category names. 42 rows. Key: `product_id`.

| Column | Type | Can be blank | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | text | No | Product ID, such as RO-1001. |
| `name` | text | No | Product name. |
| `description` | text | No | Longer product name. Equals the name where the source had none. |
| `category_id` | text | No | Two-letter category code. |
| `category_name` | text | No | Category name, such as Road Bike. |
| `supplier_partner_id` | text | Yes | Supplying partner. Blank when the supplier is unknown. |
| `list_price` | decimal | No | Gross price per unit, including 12.5% tax. |
| `currency` | text | No | Currency of the list price. |
| `quantity_unit` | text | No | Unit of sale. |
| `weight` | decimal | No | Weight per unit. |
| `weight_unit` | text | No | Unit of the weight. |
| `created_by` | text | No | Employee who created the product. |
| `created_at` | date | No | Date the product was created. |
| `changed_by` | text | No | Employee who last changed the product. |
| `changed_at` | date | No | Date the product was last changed. |

## employees

Staff who create and change orders. 14 rows. Key: `employee_id`.

| Column | Type | Can be blank | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `employee_id` | text | No | Employee ID, zero-padded. |
| `first_name` | text | No | First name. |
| `middle_initial` | text | Yes | Middle initial. |
| `last_name` | text | No | Last name. |
| `email` | text | No | Work email. |
| `login` | text | No | Login name. |
| `phone` | text | No | Phone number, in its original format. |
| `sales_org` | text | No | The one sales org the employee works in, from their address region. |

## sales_orders

One row per sales order. Amounts equal the sum of the order's line totals. 334 rows. Key: `sales_order_id`.

| Column | Type | Can be blank | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sales_order_id` | text | No | Sales order ID, zero-padded. |
| `partner_id` | text | No | Partner who placed the order. |
| `sales_org` | text | No | Sales org: AMER, APJ or EMEA. Always equals the partner's region. |
| `fiscal_year_period` | text | No | Fiscal period as YYYY0MM, from the creation month. |
| `currency` | text | No | Currency of the amounts. |
| `gross_amount` | decimal | No | Order total including tax. |
| `net_amount` | decimal | No | Order total excluding tax. |
| `tax_amount` | decimal | No | Tax on the order. |
| `lifecycle_status` | text | No | Overall status: I, C or X. |
| `billing_status` | text | No | Billing status: I, C or X. |
| `delivery_status` | text | No | Delivery status: I, C or X. |
| `created_by` | text | No | Employee who created the order. |
| `created_at` | date | No | Date the order was created. |
| `changed_by` | text | No | Employee who last changed the order. |
| `changed_at` | date | No | Date the order was last changed. |

## sales_order_items

One row per order line. A product can repeat on an order, so lines are identified by item number. 1,930 rows. Key: `sales_order_id + item_number`.

| Column | Type | Can be blank | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sales_order_id` | text | No | Order the line belongs to. |
| `item_number` | integer | No | Line number on the order: 10, 20, 30 and so on. |
| `product_id` | text | No | Product on the line. |
| `quantity` | integer | No | Units ordered. |
| `quantity_unit` | text | No | Unit of the quantity. |
| `currency` | text | No | Currency of the amounts. |
| `unit_gross_amount` | decimal | No | Price per unit including tax. |
| `unit_net_amount` | decimal | No | Price per unit excluding tax. |
| `unit_tax_amount` | decimal | No | Tax per unit. |
| `line_gross_amount` | decimal | No | Unit gross amount × quantity. |
| `line_net_amount` | decimal | No | Unit net amount × quantity. |
| `line_tax_amount` | decimal | No | Unit tax amount × quantity. |
| `delivery_date` | date | Yes | Delivery date. Blank on cancelled orders. |
